query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crm_contacts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
  phone VARCHAR(32),
  tier ENUM('lead','guardian','sovereign','ascendant','legion') DEFAULT 'lead' NOT NULL,
  source ENUM('waitlist','token_store','academy','books','nft_mint','referral','direct','social') DEFAULT 'direct' NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('new','contacted','qualified','converted','churned') DEFAULT 'new' NOT NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  stripeCustomerId VARCHAR(128),
  totalSpentCents INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales_events (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  contactId INT,
  type ENUM('purchase','upgrade','referral','refund','zakat','royalty','trading_fee') DEFAULT 'purchase' NOT NULL,
  product VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  amountCents INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  londcAmount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  stripePaymentIntentId VARCHAR(128),
  source VARCHAR(64),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creator_profiles (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  displayName VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  bio TEXT,
  walletAddress VARCHAR(128),
  coinSymbol VARCHAR(16),
  royaltyPercent DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 10.00 NOT NULL,
  totalEarningsCents INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creator_coins (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  creatorId INT NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  symbol VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  totalSupply BIGINT DEFAULT 1000000 NOT NULL,
  priceUsdCents INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  marketCapCents INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  holders INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  contractAddress VARCHAR(128),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creator_nfts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  creatorId INT NOT NULL,
  collectionName VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  imageUrl VARCHAR(512),
  totalMinted INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  maxSupply INT DEFAULT 1000 NOT NULL,
  priceUsdCents INT DEFAULT 1000 NOT NULL,
  royaltyPercent DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 10.00 NOT NULL,
  contractAddress VARCHAR(128),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kyc_records (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  status ENUM('pending','submitted','approved','rejected') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  documentType ENUM('passport','drivers_license','national_id','other') DEFAULT 'passport' NOT NULL,
  documentUrl VARCHAR(512),
  rejectionReason TEXT,
  verifiedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
